Cuyen, bitter at the slight, burned a petition and complained to Heaven; when he was denounced he took his own life.

unresolvedReferences.description: 金遺部 means remnants of the Jin people. Jin is not a person and is not in the packet polity list.
The red-fruit conception is marked 相傳 and is kept as legend. No year is invented for Bukūri Yongšon or Fekulen.
山東 in 長白山東 is east of the Changbai Mountains, not Shandong. 白山 and 長白 are fragments of 長白山.
長德 is the 長 of 長德世庫, eldest Deshiku, not a separate name.

The Xian Ancestor had five sons and Nurhaci was the eldest. Surhaci and Murhaci are two younger brothers named later. The other two are not named in this stretch and are one counted summary, not invented people.
Jiajing 38 and the cyclical year jiwei are AD 1559 by external Ming chronology. The packet has no Ming reign table. The thirteen-month pregnancy is not a conception year.
妻以女 does not count or name the daughters. They stay one family-summary rather than invented brides.
Wanli 11 and guiwei are AD 1583, external. He was twenty-five. That age is not used to recompute the birth year already stated as Jiajing 38.
甲申 names no reign. It is the cyclical year after guiwei, so AD 1584, not a chosen reign.
殲之 at Ma'erdun is not used as Neshen's death, because the same name fights and is killed at Tailangang in s0058.
戸三百 is one figure. The idiomatic each is repaired. The grant names no year; it stands before the yiyou narrative.
乙酉 names no reign. It follows jiashen and is AD 1585.
武陵 is the start of the name 武陵噶, and 吉林 is the start of the place 吉林岡. Neither is a separate person or a province.
使齋薩 is his own envoy. The idiomatic Ming envoy and the literal Zh0isa are repaired. No separate Ming agent is created.
明歲 can be read as the Ming each year or as the next year. The English each year is left, because the chapter does not decide it.
立法制 is establishing laws. The 立 is not an enfeoffment of a person.
率其子費英東等 names Feiyingdong. 等 is not turned into further sons. Hurgan's daughter is a separate person from Empress Xiaoci.
都督僉事 is Assistant Commander. Commander-in-Chief is repaired. Jichou tenth month is AD 1589 by the external cyclical sequence, not a Ming reign named in the unit.

The eighth son is Huang Taiji. The eldest is named later as Cuyen. The six between them are one counted summary, not invented people. The 25th day is not a Gregorian day. 是爲太宗 is retrospective and is not a reign year.
卦爾察 is repaired away from Guwalgiya. The nine tribes are not people.
逐北 is repaired. The Ula beile has no personal name and is not Bužantai.
The lord of Duobi is beheaded and not named. He is not made a person.
Two Korean officials attend the Ming envoys and are not named. They are not made people.
弟之女 is one niece. The brother is not identified with Šurhaci or Bayara, so no father is created.
肇祖 is an allusion to the old seat. AD 1603 is not his life date.
The brother is Nalin Bulu, already named as her elder brother. The mother has no name. 不許來 is the mother not being allowed to come.
The Dragon-Tiger General grant has no date of its own. It stands between jiachen and yisi, so AD 1604-1605, and 授 is an appointment.
神武皇帝 is the Mongol acclamation in bingwu, not the later Qing posthumous title. The five envoys are not named.
瓦爾喀 is repaired from Walgiya. Feiyucheng is 斐悠城. Mutuhei is the chief; the tribe is not a person.
立石 is setting boundary stones, not an enfeoffment. The Ming commanders are not named.
帝女 is one unnamed daughter. She is not identified with Mangusi's daughter or with the niece of the previous stretch. 鳴鏑 is a whistling arrow.
單騎奔葉赫 is Bužantai's flight. The idiomatic alone is repaired. Yehe does not surrender him, and this stretch does not say he died.
The packet jumps from s0166 to s0168. No s0167 is present, and nothing is invented for the gap.
稱都督 is how the envoys addressed him. It is not recorded as a new appointment, and it is not the earlier 都督僉事.
將授政 was withdrawn. Cuyen did not receive the government. He later hanged himself.
The ten jaruguci are not named and are not made people. The five ministers are named later in s0355.
天命元年丙辰 is AD 1616 by external chronology. The packet has no reign table. 壬申朔 is not converted to a Gregorian day. 金 is not in the packet polity list.
弟子阿敏 is a nephew. The father is not named, so he is not assigned to Šurhaci or Bayara. Birth orders 3, 4, 6, and 7 are not named. Abatai has no number and is not put in one of those slots.
Forty route chiefs receive offices and are not named. They are not made people.
經略 is repaired to supreme commander. The envoys he sent are not named.
董鄂 is Donggo, not Dong'e.
副王宣 is Wang Xuan, one deputy, not deputy kings. He and Zhao Menglin die with Du Song.
追北 is the pursuit of the defeated. Shaoqin Mountain is not evidence of a northward campaign.
Ma Lin flees here and is killed later at Kaiyuan in s0240. The flight is not his death.
Kang Yingqian flees. The unit does not say he died.
The character 立 is the last character of 姜弘立, not an enfeoffment. The Korean king is not named.
王一屏等五人 names only Wang. The other four company commanders are not named and are not made people. Abutu's earlier surrender has no year.
Buyanggu and Buirhanggu are both younger brothers of Gintaisi. Their ages relative to each other are not stated.
Ligdan's envoys are not named. One is seized here and an unnamed envoy is killed in s0258. No person is invented for him.
希福等五人 names only Hifu. The other four are not named and are not made people.
裘馬 is the gift of furs and horses. 色特希爾 is the second son, kept under the packet spelling Sete'erjiu.
The bingxu day is not converted. 總兵官 is regional commander.
The jiashen day is not converted. 穆爾哈齊 is the packet spelling Mūrhalaci in English.

Shenzong's death and Guangzong's accession and death, and Xizong's accession, are all placed in Tianming 5. No month is stated, and the Taichang month is not imported. 立 is their accession, not an enfeoffment.
萬歲 is repaired from Khan to ten thousand years.
The Zhenjiang killers are the townspeople, not named persons.
Seventeen Oirat beile are given offices and are not named. They are not made people. 授職 is appointment, not enfeoffment.
質子 is an unnamed hostage and is not made a person. Baka is not called a beile.
The envoy Ang'an killed is not named. Yuetuo is a grandson and his father is not named.
中槍卒 is Dambu. The idiomatic shot him dead is repaired. Ang'an's death is s0299.
昂安父子 does not count or name the sons. Sangtu's wives and children are not named. Sangtu himself is not said to have been killed.
諸女 are married daughters with no names or count.
庫爾𦆑等 does not name the men sent with Kurku.
The Jing and Xian ancestors are reburied. AD 1624 is not their life date.
瓦爾喀 is repaired from Walgiya. 喀爾達等 does not name his companions.
卦爾察 is repaired from Guwalgiya.
十年己卯 contradicts 十年乙丑. Jimao is not converted and is not used as the year. The names are kept. No birth order is stated for Abai, Tabai, or Babutai.
明使高第爲經略 means the Ming made Gao Di supreme commander. He is not an envoy.
士卒 are soldiers hit by the cannon. The character 卒 is not a named death. s0332 is not in this packet.
The packet jumps from s0331 to s0333. Nangnuk is the beile who is killed. Xilamulin is a place.
庚戌 follows 八月丙午 and is not converted to a Gregorian day. Tianming 11 is AD 1626 by external chronology.
He was sixty-eight. That age is not turned into a birth year. Eleven years matches the Tianming reign already narrated.
天聰三年 is AD 1629 by external Tiancong chronology. It is the burial, not a year of his life. The packet has no Tiancong reign.
立 in 立極 is part of the posthumous title, not an accession. The first title was Martial Emperor, then High Emperor, then the full title.
明夷用晦 is the hexagram Mingyi. The English Ming sun is repaired.
翦商 is the Shang allusion, repaired from Ming. The nine tribes in s0347 are not named.
岐 and 豐 are the Zhou places Qi and Feng, not people. The idiomatic founders are repaired away.
